sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Alleluia, Jesus, true and  living Bread!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Tho' the lowliest form now veil You
Here as there Your angels hail You
Branch and flow'r of Jesse's stem.
Alleluia, We in worship join with them.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Once for all when You were slain,
Alleluia, Cleansing souls from every stain.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Heav'n and earth with loud hosanna
Worship You the Lamb who died.
